# Let's check grasping page A with right arm using grasp_robowits_object or custom grasp

# Wait: if we use grasp_robowits_object on page A, where does it grasp? At center [0.433, 0.060, 0.778]!
# Wait: how wide is page A along the gripper opening axis if we use yaw_candidate_2 ([1.902768, 0.786278, 0.480936]) or yaw_candidate_0?
# Wait: page A is a flat rectangular plate lying on the table! Its thickness in Z is ~2cm, its width and length in X-Y are ~15cm x 20cm!
# Can a parallel jaw gripper with max opening 0.09m (9cm) grasp a 15cm x 20cm flat plate from above at its center?!
# NO! 9cm is smaller than 15cm! If you come from straight above at the center, the fingers will hit the top surface of the page!
# Wait: why did query_robowits_wrist_orientations say finger_sample_points_xy are [[0.307, 0.060], [0.559, 0.060]]? Because query_robowits_wrist_orientations just samples outside the AABB!

# The grippers are NOT pointing straight down! Look at wrist_left and wrist_right images, and look at the ego image!
# In the ego image, the two grippers are horizontal/angled, pointing towards each other (or forward-down)!
# Let's check the orientation of the grippers!

    name="observe_robowits_state",
